Document #022: Technical Analysis of Machine Learning Operations

1. Primary Architecture Overview
Continuous model training pipelines validate data drift.
Feature store caching reduces latency for real-time inference.
Key benchmark targets high throughput under load.
System latency remains sub-50ms at peak traffic.

2. Implementation & Empirical Results
Automated model registry tracks model weights and lineage.
Drift detection alerts trigger automated retrain workflows.
Decoupled components scale horizontally on demand.
Empirical verification confirms zero data loss.
